```{r}
library(tidyverse)
orders_eda <- readRDS("data/orders_eda.rds")
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(orders_eda, aes(x = purchase_year_month, fill = delivered_status)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~day_type) +
  labs(title = "Orders by purchase month, split by delivery status and weekday/weekend",
       x = "Purchase month", y = "Number of orders", fill = "Delivery status")
```

Order volume grew sharply through 2017 and then plateaued, and the late share is small almost everywhere except a few spikes in late 2017 to early 2018

## What each category costs

```{r}
top_cats <- orders_eda |>
  count(product_category_name_english, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 6)

top_cats
```

bed_bath_table are the most ordered category.



## Things the data says

- Order volume grew drastically throughout 2017 but then saturated in 2018
- bed_bath_table, health_beauty, sports_leisure, furniture_decor, computers_accessories and housewares are the top ordered categories
